skill.summary: Get translated dubbed videos ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your video with audio (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB), say something...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Language Editor for instant video translation and dubbing.
- Upload videos (up to 500MB), specify target language, and receive dubbed 1080p MP4 output.
- Automatic handling of session, credits, and cloud processing setup — no manual configuration required.
- Supports export, credit checking, timeline state, and multiple file types.
- Optimized for fast workflows for content creators and educators needing quick language adaptation.
